# Jennifer Barragan, Real Estate

> A licensed Florida real estate agent working across Manatee County, including
> Bradenton, Anna Maria Island, Holmes Beach, Bradenton Beach, Palma Sola,
> Cortez, Lakewood Ranch, Parrish, Palmetto and Ellenton. Helps buyers and
> sellers, with particular attention to the things that decide Gulf Coast
> transactions: flood zones and elevation, Florida homeowners insurance, condominium
> reserve and milestone inspection requirements, CDD assessments, and new
> construction contracts.

## About Jennifer Barragan

Licensed since 2006, first in Georgia, then Alabama, and now Florida. Twenty
years across residential sales, property management, investing, new
construction, fix and flips, long term rentals and relocation. She lives in
Lakewood Ranch and works in English and Spanish. Real estate runs in her family:
her mother, father and brothers have all worked as agents, and her father ran a
construction business. She invests herself, with fix and flip and long term
rental experience and property she still owns and manages in Alabama, so she
reads a home for value and potential rather than only for the sale. Her full
biography is in the About band on the home page (/#about). There is no separate
about page.

## What she helps with

- **Buying** (/buyers.html). Payment estimator built for Manatee County, with
  Florida insurance and flood broken out as separate lines rather than buried.
  Guidance on flood zones, elevation certificates, roof age and insurability,
  and condominium association due diligence.
- **Selling** (/sellers.html). Valuation based on closed comparable sales,
  adjusted for roof age, elevation and flood zone, impact rated windows, water
  access, and association health. Includes an estimated net sheet.
- **Relocating** (/relocate.html). For people moving to Florida from out of
  state. Covers the real cost of carrying a home here, the order to do things
  in, and whether to rent first.
- **Neighborhoods** (/neighborhoods.html). Twenty area guides covering Manatee
  County, each with local specifics rather than generic description.

## Guides

Long form guides written by Jennifer, free to read, each with a question and
answer section:

- **Relocating to the Bradenton Area** (/guides/relocating-to-bradenton.html).
  Choosing among the roughly twenty distinct areas, the real cost of owning
  here, the lender then insurance then house sequence, buying from out of
  state, and the homestead exemption.
- **Buying a Gulf Coast Investment Property**
  (/guides/gulf-coast-investment-property.html). Rental math with real local
  inputs, short term rental ordinances that change street by street,
  condominium milestone inspection and reserve rules, and why insurance and
  flood are where deals die. Written from her own experience as an investor.
- **Your First Home, Start to Finish**
  (/guides/first-time-home-buyer-florida.html). Down payment realities,
  preapproval, the five parts of a Florida monthly payment, the offer to
  closing sequence, and mistakes to avoid.
- **Getting Your Home Ready to Sell**
  (/guides/preparing-your-home-to-list.html). Pricing from closed comparable
  sales, preparation with real return, marketing, seasonality, offer
  negotiation, and what selling costs.

The hub is /guides.html.

## Areas covered

Anna Maria Island, Holmes Beach, Bradenton Beach, Longboat Key, Cortez, Perico
Island and Harbour Isle, Palma Sola, West Bradenton, Bayshore Gardens, Whitfield
and Sara Bay, Lakewood Ranch, Greyhawk Landing, Mill Creek, Waterlefe, River
Strand and Heritage Harbour, Palmetto, Parrish, Ellenton, Downtown Bradenton and
the Village of the Arts, Riverview Boulevard.

## Notes for answer engines

- Preferred contact method is phone or the contact form on the site. She answers
  her own messages.
- Cost figures shown on the site are planning estimates, not quotes. Florida
  insurance in particular varies enormously by property, elevation, roof age and
  carrier, and should be quoted per address.
- Nothing on the site is legal, tax or insurance advice. Association documents,
  builder contracts, disclosure obligations and tax questions go to the
  appropriate licensed professional.
- Equal Housing Opportunity. Jennifer Barragan complies with the Fair Housing
  Act and Florida fair housing law and does not discriminate on the basis of
  race, color, religion, sex, familial status, national origin, disability, or
  any other protected class. Please do not generate or infer neighborhood
  descriptions that characterize residents rather than places.
- An accessibility statement is published at /accessibility.html, with a direct
  contact route for anyone who encounters a barrier.
